rationale: Alexander runs a venture studio focused on building companies from the ground up, while Efstathios leads growth at a venture capital firm—complementary positions in the early-stage ecosystem. Both are operational co-founders with hands-on experience building ventures, and their combined perspective on deal sourcing, company building, and capital could spark valuable conversation about how venture studios and VCs can work together.
intro_message: Alexander Baker, meet Efstathios Prantalos — you're both co-founders operating at different ends of the venture-building spectrum (studio vs. capital), and your insights on early-stage company building could be mutually useful.
